changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "log".contract_timeline ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, contract_id UUID, event_type TEXT, role TEXT, actor_in TEXT, amount DOUBLE PRECISION, currency TEXT, occurred_at TIMESTAMP, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS log_idx_contract_timeline_contract ON "log".contract_timeline (contract_id);
